_job_setup_guide._note: Documentation only - validate.py does NOT read this block. Edit the sections below for each new job.
_job_setup_guide.full_documentation: See README.md and the module docstring at the top of validate.py

checklist_new_job.1_servers: Add or update server aliases under 'servers' (driver, server hostname, auth).
checklist_new_job.2_log_target: Set log_server, log_database, log_table where ValidationLog2 rows are written.
checklist_new_job.3_clients_block: One entry per job under 'clients' - this is the main job definition:
checklist_new_job.3c_tables: source_table, destination_table (used in logs only for custom_query mode)
checklist_new_job.3d_fetch_mode: Set fetch_mode to 'custom_query' when using SQL below
checklist_new_job.3e_source_fetch_query: List columns to validate in SELECT order (after join key + ClientID + AuditId). 3 value columns in query = 3 validations automatically.
checklist_new_job.3f_destination_fetch_query: Same count/order of validation columns as source. Put extra non-validated columns in exclude_from_validation.
checklist_new_job.3g_reference_keys: Join key only (usually ClientAuditId on both sides)
checklist_new_job.3h_exclude_from_validation: Optional - destination/source columns in query but NOT compared (e.g. ClaimLineUID)
checklist_new_job.3i_normalization: type: numeric for money/decimals, text for strings, date for dates
checklist_new_job.4_optional_validation_pairs: Only if source/dest columns cannot be paired by SELECT order - explicit [[source, dest], ...] in clients[]
checklist_new_job.5_options_single_pass: Keep single_pass_custom_query: true for multiple columns on same queries (faster)
checklist_new_job.6_identity_fallbacks: Only if column names differ - update identity.source_column_fallbacks / destination_column_fallbacks

usually_leave_unchanged: mappings section (not needed - auto-built from fetch queries)
options.log_granularity (per_key = one log row per audit)
queries section (SQL templates for table mode, not custom_query jobs)
validate.py and export.py (Python engine - no edit needed per job)
_job_setup_guide.current_job_example: MedicalMutual provider NPI / TaxID / OrganizationName / State / FullAddress / City check; client_id = ClientKey (27), flow_id = ClientUID (4); source sql07 (Workflow_medicalmutual), destination ncsql38 (PI_EDWDDS), destination table Reports_ActivityData; join key = ClaimSummaryUID

queries.source_key_batch: SELECT TOP ({batch_size}) {columns} FROM {table} {nolock_hint} {where} ORDER BY {order_by} ASC
queries.batch_row_fetch: SELECT {select_columns} FROM {table} t {nolock_hint} JOIN {temp_table} tmp ON {join_condition}
queries.exception_report: SELECT client_id, flow_id, audit_id, client_audit_id, source_table, source_column, destination_table, destination_column, issue_type, value_status, join_key_status, key_value, source_value, destination_value, exception_reason, batch_number, log_time, details FROM {log_table} WHERE run_id = ? AND issue_type NOT IN ({exclude_issue_types}) ORDER BY client_id, flow_id, source_table, source_column

date_formats._note: // NOT IN USE - enable when comparing date columns

_features_not_in_use.date_filter: // NOT IN USE - filter source/destination keys by date column
_features_not_in_use.fetch_mode_table: // NOT IN USE - direct table read instead of custom_query
_features_not_in_use.preload_destination_rows: // NOT IN USE - only for table fetch mode, not custom_query
_features_not_in_use.insert_custom_query: // NOT IN USE - insert/update with custom_query fetch not supported yet
_features_not_in_use.check_orphans_in_destination: // NOT IN USE - set options.check_orphans_in_destination true to enable

clients.source_fetch_query: SELECT a.ClientAuditId AS clientauditid, cs.ClaimSummaryUID, 27 AS clientkey, cs.BillingProviderNPI, cs.BillingProviderTaxID, cs.ProviderOrginazationName AS ProviderOrganizationName, cs.ProviderState, cs.ProviderFullAddress, cs.ProviderCity FROM Workflow_medicalmutual.dbo.Audit a (NOLOCK) JOIN MedicalMutualAuditClaims..ClaimSummary cs (NOLOCK) ON a.ClaimSummaryUID = cs.ClaimSummaryUID
clients.destination_fetch_query: SELECT s.SelectedClaimKey, r.ClaimSummaryUID, r.ClientKey, s.NPINumber, s.ProviderTaxID, s.ProviderOrganizationName, s.ProviderState, s.ProviderFullAddress, s.ProviderCity FROM PI_EDWDDS.dbo.SelectedClaimDim s INNER JOIN PI_EDWDDS.dbo.Reports_ActivityData r ON s.SelectedClaimKey = r.SelectedClaimKey WHERE r.ClientKey = 27 AND (s.ProviderTaxID IS NULL OR s.NPINumber IS NULL OR s.ProviderOrganizationName IS NULL OR s.ProviderFullAddress IS NULL OR s.ProviderState IS NULL OR s.ProviderCity IS NULL);
